sharedEditsNeeded: packages/containers/src/wav.ts (and likely aiff.ts/au.ts): set info.metadata for inputs whose native demuxer exports tags (WAV LIST/INFO). Probed: native copies a WAV title tag into an SMJPEG _TXT chunk, while EdgeFFmpeg accepts the tagged WAV and writes no _TXT, so tagged WAV input to -f smjpeg differs from native. Not fixable inside smjpeg.ts; documented in smjpeg-support.md.
notes: Sandbox Node was v22.23.5; bootstrap requires Node 24, so Node v24.22.3 was downloaded to the scratchpad and used for all steps.

Setup durations: npm+submodule+reference bootstrap 4m20s (reference build relinked several times because the sandbox link differs from the linux-x64 pin, expected with --allow-unpinned-reference); baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries+container registry tests 1m24s, all passing (16 registry tests).

The muxer computes the trailer duration up front (sequential output, no seek) by running framePcmPackets over a synthetic zero stream with the same framing, so the shared PREP-FRAMING API is the only regrouping code; pcm-framing.ts and framecrc.ts are untouched.
Differential file runs in about 10 s with --maxWorkers=1; the timing test uses a 64 KiB buffer budget because apad=whole_len reframing exceeds the 4 KiB budget.
No linux-gated cases: integer arithmetic and byte copies only.
